title: Unit skylights rated for the same performance grade for both positive and negative design pressure.
officialText:
The design of unit skylights shall be based on the following equation: F ≤ PG (Equation 24-13) g where:

Fg = Maximum load on the skylight determined from Equations 24-2 through 24-4 in Section 2404.2.

PG = Performance grade rating of the skylight.
